items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: This is Pee Wee Monte from Harry James, we’d like you to join the band, the first trumpet chair is open and when are you available?

ctx.x: And so we did these shows together. And so we’re driving to Spokane and he’s in the back seat and he says, “You know you guys are perfect for each other. You should get married.” And we said, “Well we’ve been talking about it.” “Oh you’ve got to get married. Why don’t we go elope.” So we didn’t stop at Spokane, we went to Cour d’Alene and we eloped. Now it gets even funnier. We get the license, go to the Justice of the Peace, and of course the Justice of the Peace is about 350 years old you know, and he

says, “Well I’m very sorry, my wife usually plays piano but she can’t play piano because she’s ill with the flu.” And I said, “Well you know who this is?” So during the ceremony I stood at the — I guess the altar — and Joe Venuti played piano — he was a very good pianist, and Gina sang at my own wedding. Okay so now we go back to work this big show and there’s about a thousand people and Joe Venuti says, “Tonight you know I get to introduce Gina Funes and Fred Radke. They just got married today” [mumbles]. And…
